title: Resolve release permission gate for AndroidX signature permission
findings_note: S22 signed minified APK aapt2 dump permissions declares and requests com.squalor.consecutor.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION in addition to the two allowed permissions.
boundary: Resolve the permission gate observed by S22. No release tagging or unrelated manifest changes.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S22 requires exactly POST_NOTIFICATIONS and RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED. The verified minified release additionally requests the app-scoped DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION. The literal gate fails; its intended treatment must be resolved without weakening receiver protection.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml; merged release manifest; S22 permission acceptance criterion and DEVELOPERS.md.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: aapt2 dump permissions on the S22 locally signed release lists three uses-permission entries instead of the specified two. Evidence: build/s22-validation/apk-permissions.txt.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Trace the extra permission to its manifest contribution and verify its protection level and receiver use.
2. Agree with the owner whether the gate should exclude an app-scoped signature permission or the merged manifest must change. Do not remove receiver protection to satisfy a count.
3. Apply the agreed bounded change and rerun the release permission and receiver checks.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: The merged, minified signed APK matches the agreed permission gate; receiver security behavior is preserved; PRIVACY.md matches.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when asked; use the project's slice worktree workflow.
